description.value: Belleville's Watering Hole & Diner is a locally owned restaurant and lounge sitting right on the edge of Victoria's Inner Harbour, in continuous operation since 2015. It offers a broad menu running from breakfast through late night, with fresh seafood, comfort food classics, craft cocktails, and local brews alongside an unobstructed harbour view. Large-group and private event bookings are available, and the Inner Harbour location puts it squarely on the path of cyclists touring the Victoria waterfront.
